name: deserttarget
note: The Desert Target pack on Meshy, the sixth of the US golf courses' landscapes (7 November 2026): Troon North, We-Ko-Pa. Saguaro (four, the owner asked for two more), palo verde and velvet mesquite; the mesquite is shared with Desert Resort. Form from the owner's Troon North photographs and the reference photographs of We-Ko-Pa and the Phoenician. Sizes PLACED. A saguaro has no leaves to find, so its far version is the cactus style, columns. `seasons` are PLACED: the palo verde's spring is its yellow bloom, drawn dull because the game's light lifts it. Shipped in vendor/blender-meshy_deserttarget as DtSaguaro, DtPaloVerde, DtMesquite, because the hand-built models hold the plain names.
style: Stylised cartoon game art in soft, flat painted colour. Simple clean shapes with a gentle gradient: darker near the trunk and under each bough, lighter toward the tips. Matte, muted natural palette. No photographic detail, no photo bark, no noise, no speckle, no hard shadows, no highlights, no shine, no ink outlines, no text.
view: One view only, seen from the side at eye level, the whole plant in frame from foot to tip with a margin around it, centred, on a plain white background, in even soft light, with no cast shadow.

Each limb ends in one large solid rounded tuft of foliage, like a soft fluffy cloud, with a lightly tufted scalloped edge. The tufts are chunky and overlap only a little, with sky and limbs showing through the gaps between them. The tufts are small and many, airy and open, making a loose rounded crown with a bumpy outline that the limbs show through.
